findings.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read & Execution
findings.description: When Vitest UI server is listening, arbitrary files can be read and executed via network request without authentication
findings.impact: Remote code execution in development environment; affects test suite execution

remediation.notes: Requires vite >=8.1.0; major version jump may require config updates

findings.title: Minizlib Uncontrolled Resource Consumption (DoS)
findings.description: Uncontrolled CPU/memory consumption via specially crafted compressed data
findings.impact: DoS during npm install or package resolution; may affect CI/CD

remediation.notes: May require full clean install (rm -rf node_modules && npm install)

findings.title: form-data CRLF Injection via Multipart Field Names
findings.description: Multipart field names and filenames not escaped for CRLF characters; allows HTTP header injection
findings.impact: Header injection in multipart uploads if untrusted filenames used

remediation.notes: Verify no untrusted filenames passed directly to form-data

findings.title: Vite Path Traversal & Windows Alternate Path Bypass
findings.description: Multiple path traversal and bypass issues: dev server can serve files outside root, Windows UNC paths bypass server.fs.deny
findings.impact: Information disclosure of source maps and private files; dev-mode attack surface

remediation.notes: Major version jump (v5 -> v8); requires vite config review and possible API updates

findings.title: ws WebSocket Memory Exhaustion DoS
findings.description: Memory exhaustion from tiny WebSocket fragments and data chunks; attacker crafts malformed frames to exhaust memory
findings.impact: DoS of dev servers using ws (live reload, HMR)

remediation.notes: Transitive dependency; fix via parent package upgrades

findings.title: JS-YAML Quadratic DoS in Merge Key Handling
findings.description: O(n²) complexity in merge key processing via repeated YAML aliases; DoS via malformed YAML
findings.impact: Test suite only (dev dependency); no prod impact

remediation.notes: Transitive fix via jest or direct js-yaml upgrade

findings.title: QS DoS via Comma-Format Arrays with encodeValuesOnly
findings.description: Crash when qs.stringify() processes null/undefined in comma-format arrays with encodeValuesOnly flag
findings.impact: Backend request parsing DoS if malformed query strings sent

remediation.notes: Transitive via body-parser; moderate backend risk

findings.title: PostCSS XSS via Unescaped </style> in CSS Output
findings.description: Unescaped </style> sequences in CSS output allow breaking out of style context and injecting HTML/JS
findings.impact: XSS in frontend if user-supplied CSS processed by postcss

remediation.notes: Transitive via vite/build tools

findings.title: Brace-Expansion Zero-Step Sequence Hang
findings.description: Zero-step sequences (e.g., {a..0}) cause infinite loop and memory exhaustion
findings.impact: Build-time DoS via glob patterns in node_modules

remediation.notes: Transitive; fixed via build tool upgrades

findings.title: React Router Open Redirect via Protocol-Relative URLs
findings.description: Same-origin redirects with path starting // reinterpreted as protocol-relative URLs; allows open redirect
findings.impact: Open redirect if routing path derived from untrusted input

remediation.notes: Current version 6.30.3 is one patch behind; audit redirect logic

findings.title: Esbuild CORS/SOP Bypass in Dev Server
findings.description: Any website can send arbitrary requests to dev server and read responses (CORS bypass)
findings.impact: Dev server security; allows cross-origin attacks from browser

remediation.notes: Fixed by upgrading vite (which includes esbuild fix)

findings.title: @babel/core Arbitrary File Read via sourceMappingURL
findings.description: Source maps with malicious sourceMappingURL comments can leak local filesystem paths
findings.impact: Information disclosure of source file paths; low CVSS (requires local access)

remediation.notes: Transitive; fixed via babel upgrades

findings.title: UUID Missing Buffer Bounds Check
findings.description: Missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when buf parameter provided; can corrupt adjacent memory
findings.impact: Memory corruption if UUID generation uses untrusted buffers; integrity risk

remediation.notes: Major version jump from 9 -> 11; verify no API breaking changes

findings.title: Express 4 Major Releases Behind
findings.description: 4 releases behind current v4 branch; v5 available but is major rewrite
findings.impact: Missing security patches and bug fixes; deprecation likely within 12-18 months

remediation.notes: Safe minor bump; plan v5 migration for next major release

findings.title: Pino 8 Major Releases Behind
findings.description: 2 major versions behind; v10 includes async improvements and better performance
findings.impact: Logging performance regressions; missing new features

remediation.notes: Upgrade to 8.21.0 for bug fixes; plan v10 migration separately

findings.title: React 18 Major Version Behind
findings.description: 1 major version behind; React 19 stable with concurrent rendering improvements
findings.impact: Missing concurrency features, performance improvements, new hooks

remediation.command: cd Source/Frontend && npm install react@latest react-dom@latest --save
remediation.notes: Plan component audit for React 19 breaking changes; likely EOL for v18 within 12 months

findings.title: React Router DOM Major Version Behind + CVE
findings.description: 1 major version behind; includes open redirect CVE (DEP-010)
findings.impact: Open redirect vulnerability (DEP-010); outdated

remediation.notes: Immediate: fix to 6.30.4; plan v7 migration for next release cycle

findings.title: Vitest 2 Major Versions Behind + CRITICAL CVE
findings.description: 2+ major versions behind; includes critical RCE CVE (DEP-001)
findings.impact: Critical RCE in test UI (DEP-001); major feature lag

remediation.notes: Requires vite >=8.1.0; can eventually migrate to v4

findings.title: Vite 5 Major Versions Behind + Multiple CVEs
findings.description: 3+ major versions behind; includes 4 high/moderate CVEs (path traversal, bypass, XSS)
findings.impact: Multiple security issues (DEP-004, DEP-008, DEP-011); major feature lag

remediation.notes: Major version jumps (v5->v6->v7->v8); review vite migration guides

findings.title: Jest Ecosystem Moderate CVEs
findings.description: Test infrastructure has transitive moderate CVEs (js-yaml DoS, brace-expansion hang, babel issues)
findings.impact: Test suite integrity; dev-only risk; no prod impact

remediation.notes: Transitive fixes via jest/babel upgrades; consider upgrading jest to latest stable

supply_chain_assessment.assessment: Moderate risk from large dev dependency tree; no post-install scripts detected (good)
